added_failures_note: The reviewed run declares no baseline_suite and no after_suite arms: it is a docs node whose declared write paths carry no test file, and its recorded gate is the read-only census (logs/gate-census-final.log, EXIT=0). With no arms there are no failure ids to subtract, so 0 derived ids and 0 added; the note records the absence rather than claiming a measured zero.

findings.text: blocking: the census's blocking set selects `row.get("name_stage") != "exhausted"` while the export gate it claims to reproduce (imas_codex/standard_names/export.py:3085-3090) requires `name_stage in _SHIPPING_NAME_STAGES` = {accepted, approved}; every roster name is name_stage 'pending' in logs/census-before.json, so none of the seven can sit in the export gate's blocking set at all, and the fragment's headline 'gate_blocking 7 -> 5' (sib-compose-stranded-stubs.html:134-135) measures draft-stage sourceless names rather than the gate. The docstring at run.py:38-40 and the sentence at .html:135 both assert 'the same filter export.py applies', which is false. The 2-name delta is real progress through the sourceless population; the label and the claim about the gate are what is wrong.

non-blocking: the paragraph states attempt_count read 0 on all nine sources while claim_seq was 5-6, but the run's own earliest census (logs/census-before.json, observed 2026-10-29T17:36:28Z) records attempt_count 1, 2 and 5 with claim_seq 7-11; the only all-zero attempt_count reading in the run is logs/census-after-unpark.json, taken after `sn retry` deliberately reset the counters. The claim is contradicted by the artefacts it summarises.

non-blocking: 'Nothing outside the roster moved' is the brief's out-of-roster check, but the runner never performs one: both census queries are scoped, the source read by `s.dd_path IN $paths` (run.py:67-78). The only whole-graph signal is gate_audit_population 15 -> 13, which counts sourceless names only and says nothing about another source's status, attempt_count or PRODUCED_NAME edge.

non-blocking: the manifest's `commits:` line lists 5377e75b8, c116b14d1 and a41f8c3ab but omits 8e953008f, the node's own first commit, which authors the initial runner and fragment (314 of the node's 512 authored lines).
